title: Anduril header
description: A fixed, 72px near-black bar: bold all-caps wordmark left, six short links centred and two utility links right (one with a +). Link labels roll up on hover with a dip in opacity. The bar slides up out of view while you scroll down and drops back as soon as you scroll up. Phones get a two-line menu button that opens a full-screen black menu with large links.
notes: fixed: it takes no room on the page, so the next section should leave 72px at its top (anduril-hero does)
needs JavaScript (hydrate: load) for hide-on-scroll and the phone menu
name: anduril-header
